# Seoul Economic Daily - English Edition
> South Korea's first economic newspaper, founded in 1960
> English news service: https://en.sedaily.com
> Korean main site: https://www.sedaily.com

## About
Seoul Economic Daily (서울경제신문) is South Korea's first economic newspaper established in 1960. We provide comprehensive coverage of Korean business, finance, technology, and economic news for international readers.

## Publisher
- Company: Seoul Economic Daily Co., Ltd.
- CEO: Son Dong-young (손동영)
- Location: Seoul, South Korea
- Contact: webmaster@sedaily.com

## News Categories
- /finance - South Korea finance, markets, banking, investments
- /technology - Korean tech industry, semiconductors, AI, startups
- /politics - Government policy, regulations, diplomacy
- /society - Demographics, labor, education, social issues
- /culture - K-culture, entertainment, creative industries
- /sports - Korean sports, athletes, international competitions
- /international - Korea in global affairs, trade, diplomacy

## Key Topics
- KOSPI and KOSDAQ stock markets
- Samsung, Hyundai, SK, LG and major Korean conglomerates
- Korean semiconductor industry
- K-pop and Korean Wave (Hallyu)
- North-South Korea relations
- US-Korea trade and alliance
- Korean economic policy

## Content Guidelines
- Original reporting from Seoul-based journalists
- English translations of selected Korean articles
- Daily updates on Korean business news
- In-depth analysis of Korean economy
